about: SRG Housing Finance Ltd, established in 1999, is an NHB-registered housing finance company focused on affordable housing finance for rural and semi-urban borrowers. Products cover home purchase, self-construction, renovation, extension and Loan Against Property (LAP). Company serves 25,000+ customers through 96 branches. [1]
